questions.question: King Lalitadiya Muktapida ruled over
questions.solution:

  • Ahmad Shah I was the first independent sultan of Gujarat, who founded Ahmedabad (1411).
  • The Chogyal (king who governs with righteousness) Palden Namgyal Thodup was crushed in 1975 and Sikkim merged with India.
  • King Mahabali ruled over Kerala.

questions.question: Chandannagar was established as a French colony in 1673, obtaining permission from the then Nawab of Bengal, ______, to establish a trading post on the right bank of the river Hooghly.
questions.solution:
• Chandannagar was established as a French colony in 1673 with permission from Nawab Ibrahim Khan of Bengal.
  • French colonies in India: Pondicherry, Karaikal, Yanam (Andhra Pradesh) on the Coromandel Coast, Mahe on the Malabar Coast, and Chandernagor in Bengal.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Hafiz (Hafez):
1. Hafiz was a 15th-century poet.
2. He was an Iranian poet.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
• Statement 1 is incorrect: Hafiz actually lived in the 14th century, not the 15th century.
  • Statement 2 is correct: He was an Iranian poet.

questions.question: In the context of Sufi traditions, what is the meaning of the word 'sama'?
questions.solution:
• 'Sama' in Sufi traditions means the recitation of sacred songs.
  • Sufism (tasawwuf) is a mystic sect of Islam that emphasizes introspection and spiritual closeness with God.

questions.question: ______ was one of the first Indian rulers to lead an armed rebellion against the British East India Company in 1824 against the implementation of the Doctrine of Lapse.
questions.solution: • Kittur Chennamma was one of the first Indian rulers to lead an armed rebellion against the British East India Company in 1824 against the implementation of the Doctrine of Lapse.

questions.question: 'Rang Ghar', one of Asia's oldest amphitheatres, was built by the king of the ______ dynasty.
questions.solution: • Rang Ghar, one of Asia's oldest amphitheatres, was built by the Ahom Dynasty king Swargadeo Promotta Singha.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Pushtimarg:
1. Vallabhacharya founded the Krishna-centered Pushtimarg sect of Vaishnavism.
2. Pushtimarg is a form of Krishna worship for adoration.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
• Both statements 1 and 2 are correct.
  • Vallabhacharya established Pushtimarg, which focuses on devotion and adoration of Krishna.

questions.question: Who among the following was the founder of the Suryavamsi Gajapati dynasty that ruled parts of Orissa and Andhra Pradesh in the 15th century?
questions.solution: • Kapilendra Deva was the founder of the Suryavamsi Gajapati dynasty that ruled parts of Orissa and Andhra Pradesh in the 15th century (1434-66 CE).

questions.question: Who among the following was the Nizam of Hyderabad in 1947?
questions.solution:
• Osman Ali was the Nizam of Hyderabad in 1947.
  • He was the last Nizam (ruler) of the Princely State of Hyderabad, ruling between 1911 and 1948.

questions.question: Which of the following is the meaning of 'Pishtaq' in the context of medieval Indo-Islamic Architecture?
questions.solution:
• 'Pishtaq' means tall gateway in medieval Indo-Islamic architecture.
  • It is a Persian/Farsi word meaning 'front of arch'.
  • It is a rectangular frame around an arched opening of buildings like mosques and palaces.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the origin of Islam:
1. Prophet Muhammad founded the faith of Islam in the 6th century CE.
2. Islam is the second-largest religion in the world.
3. Christianity is the largest religion in the world.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
• Statements 2 and 3 are correct.
  • Statement 1 is incorrect: Prophet Muhammad founded Islam in the 7th century CE, not the 6th.
  • Islam is the world's second-largest religion after Christianity.

questions.question: Who among the following was appointed as the curator of ancient monuments in 1880?
questions.solution:
• HH Cole was appointed as the curator of ancient monuments in 1880.
  • He was a British civil servant and inventor who facilitated many innovations in commerce and education.

questions.question: Who among the following was a Portuguese writer who wrote about the trade and society in South India?
questions.solution: • Duarte Barbosa was the Portuguese writer who visited India during 1500-1516 and wrote about trade and society in South India in his manuscript, 'The Book of Duarte Barbosa'.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first Portuguese viceroy of India?
questions.solution:
• Francisco de Almeida was the first Portuguese viceroy of India in 1505.
  • He was given credit for Portuguese possession in India.
